description: Points d'arrêts des bus de l'agglo is a dataset listed in Agglo du Pays de Dreux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by JVMALIN. Points d'arrêts des bus urbain et cars interurbain partenaires JVMALIN dans l'Agglo du Pays de Dreux. Coverage: Agglo du Pays de Dreux (Eure-et-Loir). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Cars, transport, jvmalin, bus. The portal shows 1,332 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-dreux-agglomeration-centrevaldeloire-portal.
